Responsive testing and debugging

Responsive testing checks real layout behavior across widths, zoom, input methods and browser
engines.
DevTools වල screen එක ටික ටික resize කරන්න. Breakpoint එකට කලින් සහ පෙස්Jස් check කරන්න.
Grid/Flex overlays බලලා tracks සහ gaps හඳුනාගන්න. Keyboard සහ zoom test කරන්න. සුබෑ device
Verify a checkout page before release.
Read the diagram: Compare phone and desktop previews; check overflow, focus and content in both.
Phone සහ desktop JදJකේම content පෙරීකේෂා කරන්න. Intermediate widths සහ zoom අමතක කරන්න එපො.
Expected result: The outline helps locate a suspicious element without changing box layout.
Interview question: Is a single mobile emulator width enough?
Answer: No. Test a range of widths, zoom, input methods and supported browsers.
Practice: Test 320, 768 and 1440px and at 200% zoom.
